title: Auroracrest Pickaxe
body:
The Auroracrest Pickaxe is a unique pickaxe and the only tool capable of mining Aurore.

Details

The pickaxe is obtained through crafting by fusing a Heart of Borealis and an Icecrest Pickaxe on a special altar located within the Icelands, while an aurora event is occurring.

This Pickaxe has a unique ability due to its nature of being made from a Icecrest Pickaxe it is unable to break any rocks aside from Aurore.


Obtaining

Note: The Auroracrest Pickaxe will not transform if it is not an aurora event.

  • Gather the two materials needed • The Icecrest Pickaxe can be bought from the Ice Golem Shop for $24,000. • The Heart of Borealis can be found in the Snowlands during a Aurora event .

With the materials acquired, proceed to the next step. For people who prefer a video guide, follow along with this Youtube Video.
